_doc: Ultramarines Intercessor: every model-specific fix from v1 (configs/intercessor_anim.json). Pose 1 is the frame the user chose for v1 and is the regression test (configs/regression/intercessor_v1.json). Eye-height rule (Derek 2026-10-25): rest-pose eye height 35.5 mm (Assault Intercessor photo 35.5 (forum 35)); lens/eye line 39.2 mm at the global factor read off a head render. GW measurements 2026-10-25: eye height 34.22 mm (Assault Intercessor (my reading, sole convention aligned via the Legionary); 34.952160493827165 mm x 28.0/28.6).
base_size_source: v1 (user-confirmed Citadel 32 mm); Stage 4 checks it against the GW base guide
